summary: Status of the HTTP request log file
description:
The status of the HTTP request log file (HTTPDebugLog_nn.txt, stored in the "Logs" folder of the application -- nn is the file number).

0 = disabled 1 = enabled without body parts (body size is provided in this case) 3 = enabled with body parts in response only 5 = enabled with body parts in request only 7 = enabled with body parts in response and request
